facts.statement: The genus Chondrenchelys was described by Traquair in 1888.
Chondrenchelys was a medium-sized fish with an elongated body reaching up to 18 cm in length.

facts.statement: Chondrenchelys lived during the Visean stage, from 346.7 to 339.9 million years ago.
